title: Worktree seeding
description: Adds .worktreeinclude, from which Paseo and Claude Code copy the gitignored files a new worktree needs before its setup or first agent runs: .env files, Claude Code local settings, mise.local.toml and, through an expr on the commit_* answers, the tooling those answers keep out of git, .worktreeinclude itself included. A failed copy aborts the worktree, so the listed directories must never hold a symlink, which is why the .claude/skills/ links are left out.

content.expr:
'' if commit_skills and commit_mcp and commit_mise and commit_instructions else '

# Personal tooling
' + '
'.join([p for p, kept_out in [('/.agents/', not commit_skills), ('/.codex/', not commit_mcp), ('/.mcp.json', not commit_mcp), ('/.omp/', not commit_mcp), ('/.worktreeinclude', True), ('/AGENTS.md', not commit_instructions), ('/mise.toml', not commit_mise)] if kept_out])
